description: A Smart Data Hub to integrate subsurface properties into model-based decision-support tools is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Qian Chen et al. The selection of suitable nuclear waste disposal sites is a long and challenging process, involving multiple technical and environmental assessments. For data-integrated simulation models to function as credible decision-support tools in this sensitive context, their data sources must meet rigorous transparency and reproducibility standards. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, Image. The data are held in RWTH Aachen University and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: pages 1-25. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC BY 4.0, taken from the Data Records or Data Availability section of the paper. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
